description: The server takes the client's first two messages and drops the connection before answering each (a reply lost on the way back, or a server that took the message and then failed): a new run whose first replies are lost. Each message the client sends again is number 0, so the server sees a new run whichever arrives, until a message is answered; then 1, 2, ... (RULE-CLIENT-20). Over WebSocket each loss is a connection lost before an answer, so the client backs off between them.
